sceneBrief.title: What Follows in the Dark
sceneBrief.emotionalGoal: Pure adrenaline and dread — the reader should feel chased, trapped, and running out of time
sceneBrief.payoff: The archive room is set on fire with Sarah inside; she escapes with partial records but Ramirez is injured in the explosion
sceneBrief.tension: Very high — a chase through a burning building with a race against time to save evidence and a partner

draft:
The archive was in the basement.

Sarah took the stairs two at a time, her torch beam cutting through dust so thick it looked like fog. The air was cold and stale and wrong. She hit the bottom landing and stopped.

The door to the archive room was open.

Not broken. Not forced. Open, as if someone had just walked through it.

She drew her weapon. 'Police. Identify yourself.'

Silence. Then, from somewhere in the dark ahead, a single footstep on stone.

Sarah moved forward, her back to the wall, the torch in her left hand, her sidearm in her right. The archive room was vast — rows of metal shelving stretching into darkness, each shelf crammed with boxes and ledgers and rolled maps. The air smelled of old paper and something else. Something chemical.

She heard the second footstep behind her and turned.

A figure stood in the doorway, silhouetted against the dim light from the stairwell. Tall. Still. Watching.

'You are not supposed to be here, Detective.' The voice was low, almost gentle. 'This is family business.'

'Step into the light. Now.'

The figure did not move. But something else did — a flicker at the edge of her vision, orange and hungry. The chemical smell resolved into petrol.

'You have thirty seconds,' the figure said. 'I would run.'

The door slammed shut. A bolt slid home.

And the fire caught.

Sarah ran. The flames raced along the floor, leaping from shelf to shelf, turning decades of paper into instant torches. The heat was monstrous, immediate, a physical wall pushing her back. She coughed, dropped low, crawled toward the door.

It would not budge.

Above her, the ceiling began to burn.

Then the door exploded inward — not from the fire, but from the other side. Ramirez stood in the缺口, his shoulder bloody, his face black with smoke. He grabbed her arm and pulled.

'Move, move, move!'

They ran up the stairs together, the fire roaring behind them like a living thing. The moment they burst through the ground-floor door, the floor beneath them groaned. Sarah kept running, dragging Ramirez with her, until they were across the lawn and on the gravel drive, gasping.

She looked back. The east wing of the manor was engulfed.

Ramirez slumped to his knees, pressing a hand to his shoulder. Blood seeped between his fingers.

'I'll call an ambulance,' Sarah said, already reaching for her radio.

'Did you get anything?' he asked.

She looked down at her hand. Clutched in it, somehow, was a single charred ledger page, its edges still smoking.

'I got something.'
storyBible:
Character: Detective Sarah Chen
Role: Protagonist / Lead Detective
Goal: Solve the murder of Dr. Eleanor Vance and uncover the truth behind a cold case
Voice: Direct, observant, dry humour under pressure, methodical
Notes: Transferred from Homicide to Cold Case six months ago after a personal tragedy; carries guilt she masks with procedure
Traits: thorough, intuitive, guarded, stubborn

Character: Officer Mike Ramirez
Role: Uniformed first responder / Sarah's partner on this case
Goal: Protect Sarah and secure the evidence
Voice: Professional, grounded, acts before he thinks when someone he cares about is in danger
Notes: 18-year veteran; has developed a quiet loyalty to Sarah because he recognises her competence and her grief; took a shrapnel injury in the explosion
Traits: observant, loyal, brave, steady

Character: Unidentified Figure
Role: Antagonist / Arsonist
Goal: Destroy the Rosethorn archives before the investigation can uncover the truth
Voice: Low, calm, almost gentle — the calmness is more terrifying than anger would be
Notes: Appears to have intimate knowledge of the Rosethorn estate; knows the archive layout, the petrol storage, and Sarah's movements
Traits: methodical, patient, ruthless

Location: Rosethorn Archive Basement
Description: Vast underground archive room with rows of metal shelving containing centuries of Rosethorn family records, maps, and ledgers; accessed via a single heavy door from a stone stairwell
Notes: The archive contains the evidence Margaret found 27 years ago; someone has decided to destroy it rather than let Sarah see it
Traits: vast, cold, flammable, claustrophobic
chapterLog:
Scene 1 — The Body in the Garden: Sarah discovered Eleanor Vance's body in the fountain, clutching research on the Rosethorn family.
Scene 2 — The Heir's Denial: Sarah interviewed Marcus Rosethorn, who revealed his twin sister Margaret disappeared in 1998.
Scene 3 — The Archivist's Secret: Sarah found Margaret living in hiding on the estate. Margaret revealed their father tried to kill her after she discovered evidence of the family's criminal origins. She gave Sarah a stack of documents.
Scene 4 — What Follows in the Dark: Sarah and Ramirez returned to the manor to access the main archive. Sarah descended to the basement archive alone while Ramirez waited at the top of the stairs.
